FLAG CHECK: ARK prints NO sparsity footnote anywhere on this page. 'GPU Peak TOPS (Int8) 367' is stated as a single unsuffixed figure on the integer matrix path, so dense:true is the correct reading and there is no dense/sparse ambiguity to resolve on this record. Note also that ARK prints no 'Graphics Memory Speed' row for this SKU (contrast the Arc B580 ARK page, which prints 19 Gbps), so the 19 Gbps per-pin rate implied by 608 GB/s at 256 bit is NOT a vendor-stated figure here and must not be recorded as a field value.
No host-link bandwidth figure in GB/s is published by Intel; 'PCI Express 5.0 x16' is the entire interconnect statement, so any per-direction GB/s number on this record would be derived, not quoted.
